report_name: Buckinghamshire Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used to forecast potential future demand for cycling to work and to school under different scenarios, accounting for trip distance and hilliness, to help identify potential for active travel.
other_tools_developed: Digital mapping software was used to calculate likely scale of trips and to map local aspirations identified by Councillors and Community Boards; priority corridors were selected based on criteria including high potential for active travel journeys and alignment with local aspirations.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The Waddesdon Greenway, delivered in 2018, recorded over 160,000 trips in 2020 and subsequently benefited from an 800m extension to connect into Waddesdon village via local schools.
pct_usage_quote: The government-funded Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) forecasts potential future demand for cycling to work and to school under different scenarios, accounting for trip distance and hilliness.
